responsive.breakpoint: Mobile-first approach. All components must look good on mobile and scale up.
responsive.layout: On mobile: Sidebars become hamburger menus or bottom nav. Grids collapse to 1 column. Horizontal charts become scrollable or simplified. Forms stack vertically.
responsive.typography: Use fluid typography or Tailwind's responsive text utilities (text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl). Do not use excessively large text on mobile.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-x-hidden on the main container. Check data tables for horizontal overflow (use overflow-x-auto on table wrappers).
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44px. Add min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] to icon buttons.

motion.hover: Subtle translate-y-[-2px] and shadow elevation for cards. Background color shifts for buttons.
motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out for standard interactions. Do NOT use universal transitions (transition: all) on elements that scale/transform heavily.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade-in and slide-up for dashboard widgets.

components.name: Card
components.instructions: Override default Shadcn card. Use rounded-xl, border-slate-200, shadow-sm, and generous padding (p-6). Avoid heavy drop shadows.

components.name: Progress
components.instructions: Use gold (#D4AF37) for the progress indicator fill to emphasize success and momentum.

components.name: Button
components.instructions: Make buttons pill-shaped (rounded-full) for a more approachable, empowering feel.

components.name: Tabs
components.instructions: Style tabs as segmented controls or distinct clean text links with an active underline, overriding the standard Shadcn boxy look.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Gold text on white background must be dark enough (#AA8C2C or #D4AF37 if large text).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have clear focus rings. focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#D4AF37] focus-visible:ring-offset-2

icons.instructions: Use consistent stroke widths. For the Dashboard, use friendly, rounded icons. Avoid strictly technical or penal-looking icons (no chains, gavels, or harsh grids).

hero_marketing.description: Modern building reflecting sky in abstract mirrored facade, showing golden hues.

professional_group.description: A diverse group of professionals posing confidently in a modern office environment. Use for 'Support Circle' or 'Rebuilding Identity'.

professional_women.description: Four professional women standing confidently in an office, symbolizing diversity and teamwork.

abstract_gold_blue.description: Abstract view of a modern glass facade with blue windows and gold frames. Use for backgrounds or card banners.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the user choices carefully. The application must NOT look like a government or correctional portal. It must be premium, modern, and serious, but encouraging.
Brand colors are Deep Navy (#0A192F), White, and Gold (#D4AF37). Use Navy for structure, headers, sidebars, and primary text. Use Gold for accents, buttons, and progress bars.
Implement a mobile-first responsive layout. Ensure the sidebar becomes a hamburger menu or bottom navigation on mobile. Stagger cards into a single column on small screens.
Ensure generous spacing between sections. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards so content doesn't feel cramped.
In the My Blueprint Dashboard, emphasize progress and upcoming milestones using timelines and progress bars.
Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
The UI should use subtle glassmorphism for sticky headers (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b`). Do not use completely transparent headers.
Use `lucide-react` for icons. Keep them approachable.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-button"`).
Avoid using Shadcn `Card` everywhere if it makes the layout look rigid; mix in flat rectangular sections and custom HTML/Tailwind for marketing/landing areas.
Bridge AI assistant should be clearly visible but non-intrusive, styled with an empowering tone. Perhaps a floating action button in gold or navy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft shadows.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
DO NOT center align the app container using `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or rounded-full) with interaction animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠) for icons. Use proper SVG icons.
Ensure you add data-testid to interactive elements.
